name: Claude Code (Panem agent)
description: Claude Code as a Panem agent: installs Claude Code, trusts the pod's repos, and keeps a Remote Control session running (open it in the Claude app). Brings the Panem pod base along if the template doesn't list it.

installClaude.description: Install Claude Code with the native installer. Set false if the image already has it.

remoteControl.description: Start `claude remote-control` in tmux on every container start.

permissionMode.description: Permission mode for sessions started through Remote Control.
